=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:line 249 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The §15 GitHub API call hygiene constraint references a non-existent Phase Q reviewer routing classifier.
  WHY: The plan only defines phases A–P, so the cross-reference points to a phase that does not exist.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:line 292 | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The `/freeze` row in the "Where we're already ahead" table attributes the finer-grained per-issue label to Phase M instead of Phase L.
  WHY: The phase definitions place the scope-lock label in Phase L, so the table misattributes the feature.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase O description (~lines 1390-1440) and OQ-4 (~line 1556) | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Phase O's Jinja2 renderer has no fallback or resolution for OQ-4's unresolved decision about sharing an engine with Symphony's Jinja2 plan.
  WHY: Without that decision, Phase O can produce an incompatible or duplicate template engine implementation.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase L section, Implementation step 4 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The post-commit verification step uses `git diff --name-only HEAD~1`, which assumes a single-parent commit.
  WHY: That baseline breaks on merge or initial commits and can miss or misreport scope violations.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase I section, point 5 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `qwen/qwen3.6-plus` model slug may not be registered in the codex model catalog used by the pipeline.
  WHY: If the slug is missing, the dispatcher falls back to bundled metadata and the reviewer routing may fail.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase F section, Implementation step 1 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The retro aggregation logic does not define behavior when the ai-memory branch exists but is empty or corrupted.
  WHY: That omission can produce silent failures or misleading retro summaries.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase L section, Implementation step 3 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The scope-lock enforcement has no fallback if `IMPLEMENTER_SCOPE_GLOB` is unset or not propagated.
  WHY: Without the variable, the implementer prompt may omit the scope restriction and allow out-of-scope edits.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase O section, Implementation step 6 | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The assembled prompt files written to `prompts/_assembled/mode-*.txt` have no cleanup or rotation policy.
  WHY: Stale files can accumulate and be confused with current assembled prompts.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase C section, Implementation list | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The `validate-discover` persona naming is inconsistent with the `mode-validate-discover.txt` file-name pattern used elsewhere in the document.
  WHY: This inconsistency can confuse implementers wiring persona names to prompt filenames.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase P section ("Phase P: AGENTS.md materiality finding in consolidator"), first paragraph of Implementation | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The phrase "not adding a 9th lens to keep the 8-lens count stable" implies the count is already 8 before Phase P, which is internally inconsistent with the plan's phase ordering.
  WHY: Phase M is the change that introduces the 8th lens, so the baseline count wording is backwards.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase C section, Implementation bullet 3 | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The document says there are 16 persona blocks in Phase C, but the listed persona entries total 17.
  WHY: The mismatch means either one persona is missing from assembly or the count in the plan is wrong.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Constraints section, bullet 4 ("§15 GitHub API call hygiene") | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `agents.md:130-147` anchor for stable log prefixes may be stale.
  WHY: Hard-coded line numbers in a plan can drift and send implementers to the wrong section.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase A, Status section — "prompts/mode-plan.txt enforces a <= 60-minute implementation-time estimate (line 11)" | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The `prompts/mode-plan.txt` line reference for the <= 60-minute implementation-time estimate points to line 11 instead of lines 12-13.
  WHY: The wrong anchor will slow readers trying to find the actual constraint.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase D, Status section — "prompts/mode-implement-diagnose.txt already emits structured JSON fix-up-issue proposals (per agents.md:30-32)" | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The `agents.md` line reference for the JSON fix-up-issue proposal points to lines 30-32 instead of 28-30.
  WHY: The anchor is off by a few lines and points at the wrong subsection.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase L, Implementation step 4 — post-commit verification step | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The post-commit verification/revert flow in Phase L does not explain how to safely revert after the commit has already been pushed.
  WHY: As written, it can require destructive git operations that conflict with the no-destructive-ops constraint.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase M — adds an 8th consolidator lens; Phase P extends an existing lens "not adding a 9th lens to keep the 8-lens count stable" | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Adding the 8th consolidator lens in Phase M is not accompanied by any update to the consumer contract that validates the existing 7-lens enumeration.
  WHY: Downstream consumers could drop or reject findings for the new lens category.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase L section, Implementation step 4 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The post-commit verification step references `git diff --name-only HEAD~1` which assumes the commit has exactly one parent.
  WHY: For merge commits or initial commits in a branch, this could produce incorrect results and miss violations or generate false positives.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase I section, point 5 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The reviewer tier for `lite` specifies `qwen/qwen3.6-plus` as the cheapest slug, but this model identifier may not exist in the `scripts/codex_model_catalog.json` file that the pipeline uses for model resolution.
  WHY: If the slug isn't registered, the dispatcher emits a warning and falls back to bundled metadata, which could cause tool-call emission failures similar to the gpt-5.4 issue described in agents.md.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase F section, Implementation step 1 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The retro aggregation logic reads ai-memory records with "one paginated read; fail-open on missing branch" but doesn't specify how it handles the case where the ai-memory branch exists but is empty or corrupted.
  WHY: If the ai-memory branch is initialized but contains no records or has malformed records, the aggregation script may fail silently or produce misleading retro summaries with zero counts.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase L section, Implementation step 3 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The scope-lock enforcement depends on the `IMPLEMENTER_SCOPE_GLOB` environment variable being injected into the codex-cli run, but there's no specified fallback if the environment variable is unset due to workflow misconfiguration.
  WHY: If the label parser fails or the environment variable isn't propagated correctly, the implementer prompt won't receive the scope restriction and could allow edits outside the intended scope without any warning or BLOCKED emission.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase O section, Implementation step 6 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The assembled prompts are written to `prompts/_assembled/mode-*.txt` at workflow setup time, but the document doesn't specify cleanup or rotation logic for these generated files.
  WHY: Over multiple workflow runs, the `_assembled/` directory could accumulate stale prompt files and potentially confuse the active assembled version.
- docs/plans/gstack-learnings-plan.md:Phase C section, Implementation list | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The persona for `validate-discover` is described as "Validation-scope discoverer." but the file name referenced elsewhere in the document uses `mode-validate-discover.txt` which doesn't match the pattern used for other validate personas.
  WHY: The document lists both `mode-validate-discover.txt` and `validate-discover` inconsistently, which could confuse implementation of Phase C.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

  WHY: Implementers may search the plan for "Phase Q" and find nothing, creating confusion about whether a phase was dropped or mislabeled.

  WHY: The current consolidator has 7 lenses, Phase M adds the 8th, and Phase P extends an existing lens without adding another, so the baseline count wording is backwards.

  WHY: The Phase O prelude file expects 16 keyed blocks, so the count is off by one and will leave the assembly contract ambiguous.
